description: Reads the DNS records in the zone Scopeweb hosts for a domain this account registered here: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT and SRV, each with its name and value, whether the zone is answering in public DNS, and the newest change with the change_id that undoes it. For when the user wants to see where a domain points before or after changing it. Read-only. Cannot spend money.
